## Machine learning

::: {.lesson-grid}
::: {.lesson-card}
### [SVM: Classical and Quantum Kernel Classifiers](svm-classical-vs-quantum/)

A four-part series from two-feature SVM margin geometry to a side-by-side comparison of classical and quantum kernels.

**Prerequisites:** vectors, inner products, and basic Python.
:::

::: {.lesson-card}
### [Logistic and Mixed-Effects Regression](logistic-mixed-effects/)

A two-part medical example covering binary outcomes, odds ratios, p-values,
clinical interpretation, and patients clustered within clinics.

**Prerequisites:** basic algebra and introductory R.
:::
:::

More lessons will be added as independent, downloadable notebooks.

## Optimization

::: {.lesson-grid}
::: {.lesson-card}
### [Optimization: Primal and Dual](optimization-primal-dual/)

A two-part lesson that starts with a simple constrained minimization problem and then derives its Lagrangian dual.

**Prerequisites:** algebra, derivatives, and basic Python.
:::
:::

## Power systems

::: {.lesson-grid}
::: {.lesson-card}
### [Power Flow and State Estimation](power-flow-state-estimation/)

A three-part pandapower lesson comparing AC load flow with WLS state
estimation, then exploring measurement observability on the same five-bus grid.

**Prerequisites:** complex numbers, basic circuits, probability, and linear algebra.
:::
:::
